newsitem.title: USA: OTR Express Q4 net loss widens, costs up.
newsitem.headline: OTR Express Q4 net loss widens, costs up.

text.p: OTR Express Inc said Tuesday higher diesel fuel prices and a charge to increase insurance reserves for loss developement contributed to a wider loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company reported a loss of $287,000, or $0.16 a share, compared with a loss of $88,000, or $0.05 a share, one year ago.
OTR said the record-high gas prices had an impact of about $0.06 a share, while the charge totaled about $0.05 a share.
Revenues in the period increased to $14.4 million from $13.2 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
OTR is a long-haul truckload carrier. Its shares closed down 1/8 Tuesday at 3-3/8.
